facts.value: Both rounded arena bounds zero selects OSAllocFromHeap(__OSCurrHeap,size), with a NULL result causing panic. Otherwise returns rounded arena-low after adding size, comparing the resulting cursor against raw OSGetArenaHi, and committing it. The routine has no zero-size, size-alignment, integer-wraparound, or nonnull arena-base check; an ordinary return is not an unconditional validity guarantee for arbitrary inputs.
facts.rationale: Correct unchecked input/failure guarantees, internal GX direction representation, heap-selection scope, or free-count meaning.

facts.value: Null render mode returns NULL before mutation. Otherwise writes accounting and fills the fixed three-entry FrameBuffer table from the OS current heap when rounded arena bounds are equal, or from aligned arena-low slots otherwise. It does not validate nbuffer, so negative or greater-than-three counts can index outside the table. Heap allocation results are stored without NULL checks. The arena path checks capacity only after assigning all requested slots, then commits OS arena-low. Remaining slots are cleared and the table returned; return of the table does not prove every heap allocation succeeded.
facts.rationale: Correct unchecked input/failure guarantees, internal GX direction representation, heap-selection scope, or free-count meaning.

facts.value: Calls GXInitLightPos and GXInitLightDir with (1,0,0), and GXInitLightAttn with both coefficient triples (1,0,0), then supplies the zero GXColor. Position is stored directly; GXInitLightDir negates its inputs into the internal direction fields. Indices0-7 map to the eight GX light identifiers for upload of this object, then HSD_StateInvalidate(-1) invalidates every represented category.
